title: Malaysia requires strong political will to raise revenue - Moody's | The Star
text:
Malaysia requires strong political will to raise revenue - Moody's | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia requires a great degree of political will to raise its revenue, said Moody’s Investors Service.
Senior vice-president (sovereign risk group) Christian de Guzman said the overall support for the economy had dwindled over time due to the emphasis on fiscal consolidation in the past.
